sentences.text_en: Long, long ago, in a town called Nazareth, an angel named Gabriel came to a kind woman named Mary.
sentences.text_ko: 아주 오랜 옛날, 나사렛이라는 동네에 가브리엘이라는 천사가 마리아라는 착한 여인에게 찾아왔어요.

sentences.text_en: Do not be afraid, Mary.
You will have a special baby.
sentences.text_ko: 너는 특별한 아기를 갖게 될 거야.

sentences.text_en: His name is Jesus, and He is God's Son!
sentences.text_ko: 아기의 이름은 예수님이고, 그분은 하나님의 아들이란다!

sentences.text_en: Soon, Mary and her husband Joseph had to go to a town called Bethlehem to write their names.
sentences.text_ko: 얼마 뒤, 마리아와 남편 요셉은 호적을 기록하기 위해 베들레헴이라는 동네로 가야 했어요.

sentences.text_en: The town was very full.
sentences.text_ko: 동네는 사람들로 아주 꽉 차 있었어요.

sentences.text_en: There was no room for them to sleep anywhere.
I am sorry, but my rooms are full.
You can stay in the stable with the animals.
That night, baby Jesus was born in the humble stable.
sentences.text_ko: 그날 밤, 아기 예수님이 소박한 마구간에서 태어났어요.

sentences.text_en: Mary wrapped Him in soft cloths and laid Him in a manger.
sentences.text_ko: 마리아는 아기를 부드러운 천으로 감싸 구유에 뉘었답니다.

sentences.text_en: Do not be afraid!
Today, a Savior is born in Bethlehem.
Go and see the baby!
Shepherds in the fields saw bright angels and heard the good news.
sentences.text_ko: 들판에 있던 목자들이 밝은 천사들을 보고 기쁜 소식을 들었어요.

sentences.text_en: They ran to the stable to see baby Jesus.
sentences.text_ko: 그들은 아기 예수님을 보기 위해 마구간으로 달려갔답니다.

sentences.text_en: Look at the baby!
He is sleeping peacefully.
God has given us a great gift!
Jesus is born!
Merry Christmas and thank you, God, for Your great love!
sentences.text_ko: 메리 크리스마스, 그리고 큰 사랑을 주신 하나님 감사합니다!
